data.name: Aydin
data.gender_notes: Aydin is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Aydin refers to the guiding light that shines brightly, symbolizing guidance and wisdom in Islamic tradition. The name Aydin carries the meaning “Guiding Light” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aydin usually hope their child will grow to embody guiding light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The Quran describes the Prophet Muhammad as a guiding light, guiding humanity towards the right path.
data.etymology: Aydin belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Guiding Light.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aydin total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: أيدين
in_arabic.meaning: إشارة إلى الشخص الذي يملك بصيرة أو فهم واضح
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم أيدين مشتق من اللغة العربية، ويعني الشخص الذي يملك القدرة على التمييز بين الحق والباطل، أو الشخص الذي يملك بصيرة واضحة في الأمور. وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم عدة مرات في سياق الإشارة إلى الذين يتبعون هدى الله تعالى.

in_urdu.name: ایدین
in_urdu.meaning: بصیرت یا واضح سمجھ رکھنے والا شخص
in_urdu.long_meaning: اسم ایدین عربی मूल سے اخذ کیا گیا ہے، اور اس کا مطلب ہے وہ شخص جو حق اور باطل کے درمیان تمیز کرنے کی صلاحیت رکھتا ہے، یا جس کے پاس امور میں واضح بصیرت ہے۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیاء میں مسلمانوں کے ذریعہ ایک مقبول انتخاب ہے، خاص طور پر پاکستان اور بھارت میں.

in_hindi.name: आयदीन
in_hindi.meaning: स्पष्ट समझ या अंतर्दृष्टि रखने वाला व्यक्ति
in_hindi.long_meaning: आयदीन नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा से हुई है, और इसका अर्थ है वह व्यक्ति जो सही और गलत के बीच भेद करने में सक्षम है, या जिसके पास मामलों में स्पष्ट अंतर्दृष्टि है। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में एक लोकप्रिय विकल्प है, विशेष रूप से भारत और अन्य दक्षिण एशियाई देशों में।

in_pashto.name: آيدين
in_pashto.meaning: د حق او باطل د پوهې او بصیرت لرونکی کس
in_pashto.long_meaning: د آيدين نوم په عربي ژبه کې ریشه لري، او معنی یې هغه څوک دی چي د حق او باطل تر منځ د توپیر کولو وړتیا لري، یا چي په چارو کي يې روښانه بصیرت شته. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دودیزو ټولنو کې یو مشهور انتخاب دی.

in_english.name: Aydin
in_english.long_meaning: Aydin is an Islamic name with Arabic roots, derived from 'a-y-d' which means 'to guide' or 'to enlighten'. It signifies a person with clear vision, understanding, and spiritual guidance. Historically, the name Aydin has been used across various Muslim cultures to denote scholars, wise individuals, and those who possess inner light and knowledge.

data.cultural_impact: The name Aydin, originated from the Arabic language, holds a rich cultural significance. In Turkey, it is a common name for both males and females, symbolizing courage, spiritual strength, and resilience. In the wider Islamic world, Aydin is revered as a name that brings to mind the important role of guidance and wisdom in our lives.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Aydin is deeply rooted in the religious values of Islamic tradition. It is believed to be a reminder of the importance of seeking guidance from Allah, who is referred to as the "Light of Guidance" in the Quran. The name Aydin can also be seen as a personal invitation to be a beacon of light for others, sharing wisdom and knowledge to help guide those who may be lost. Ultimately, the name Aydin embodies the spirit of seekers of truth and wisdom, inspiring individuals to be vigilant in their pursuit of knowledge and to use it to uplift and enlighten the lives of those around them.
